title: Bakery · Enterprise composition review
question: What should carry forward? These views can coexist. Approve a starting point, combine them, or describe what should change before the editable desktop and mobile designs.

options.label: A · Work queue
options.body: A compact work list with a task inspector. Best for choosing what needs attention and keeping the queue moving. Generated composition study; example data is synthetic.

options.label: B · Shared session
options.body: Codex-like session navigation, shared conversation, and a plan with comments. The strongest foundation for working with agents and other people. Generated composition study; controls are illustrative.

options.label: C · Applications
options.body: Application status, active work, release evidence, and worker health in one operational view. A companion to the queue and session workspace. Generated composition study; example data is synthetic.
